task.description:
Final rework (3 of 3) to resolve GBL-077 migration DDL phase failure blocking ISS-104 testing.

From Rework 2 investigation:
- GBL-077 pre-flight check now PASSES (verified)
- But GBL-077 DDL phase still fails with ServerError
- DDL phase includes: DROP DEFAULT, drop RLS policies, drop columns, drop function

This is the final rework attempt. If unresolved, escalation required.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test passes all unit tests

result.summary: Rework 3 (final attempt): Fixed migration ordering and refactored GBL-077 with idempotent exception handlers. Migration ordering issue resolved. However, GBL-077 still fails at DDL phase with generic ServerError. Root cause cannot be determined due to exception handler suppression of PostgreSQL error messages. All rework attempts (1-3) exhausted. Escalation required for human review.

issues.description: GBL-077 migration DDL phase returns ServerError despite pre-flight check passing. Cannot determine root cause: exception handlers in migration suppress actual PostgreSQL error. Test harness returns generic error.ServerError to caller without error message details.
issues.investigation: Rework 1 fixed migration ordering. Rework 2 fixed pre-flight check. Rework 3 fixed DEFAULT clause drops and exception handling. All 3 reworks aimed at resolving migration failures, but underlying DDL error remains hidden.
attempted_fixes: Moved ALTER COLUMN DROP DEFAULT before DROP COLUMN (Rework 3)
Refactored nested DO blocks to inline exception handlers (Rework 3)
issues.next_steps: Escalate to human review. Options: (1) Enhanced logging in pg/Zig or test harness to surface PostgreSQL error, (2) Manual PostgreSQL testing with schema snapshot, (3) Skip GBL-077 in test harness to unblock ISS-104.

result.next_action: ESCALATE to human review for GBL-077 root cause analysis (rework attempts exhausted 3/3)
